messages.subject: Write a number in apex and write ≥ in  qplot
parts:
Hi,

I want to write in my qplot a text were I have a number in apex (R^2, but without ^) and also I want write the ≥ and ≤.

Does anyone know how to do this?

Thaks!

Fede

messages.author: 0c39e60ddb38622b
messages.subject: Re: Write a number in apex and write ≥ in qplot
parts:
Since your question is too general to provide a specific answer, I'd start with
https://github.com/hadley/ggplot2/wiki/Plotmath

As for the >= and <= signs, see ?plotmath. From experience, you can
use the plotmath syntax once. If you want to do something like a <= X
<= b, you'll need to use the Unicode version of the symbol for the
second instance. Whether you use a character string of plotmath code
or (a list of) expressions depends on where you want to place the
annotation, as described in the link above.

If you provide a reproducible example (Google "R reproducible example"
if this is a new concept to you), someone should be able to provide
more specific help.

Dennis
